hook.line: Everyone in the café has an opinion about Altamira. At some point Tomás has to say: fine, you may be right, but this is what matters. That is what these phrases do.
hook.es:
Es caro y queda lejos.
En cualquier caso, es la única opción.
hook.en:
It's expensive and it's far away.
In any case, it's the only option.

rule:
These phrases say: "whatever was just said, this is what counts". They admit the objection might be true and then set it aside.

*En cualquier caso* and *en todo caso* pick the main line: "in any case".
*De todos modos* is everyday "anyway".
*Al fin y al cabo* gives the deeper reason: "after all".

They do not answer the objection. Used on someone with a real worry, they can sound like you did not listen. Don't mix them up with *o sea* and *es decir*: those say the same thing again, while these move past it.
smallPrint: Teachers call these concessive or distancing reformulators: you grant the point and move past it.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick *de todos modos* or *es decir* and type the whole sentence, to set the worry aside: *Llueve mucho. ___, abrimos a las ocho.*
yourTurn.answer: Llueve mucho. De todos modos, abrimos a las ocho.
accept: Llueve mucho. De todos modos abrimos a las ocho.
yourTurn.why: You are not rephrasing the rain, you are ignoring it, so *de todos modos*.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: After all, nobody forced me.
yourTurn.answer: Al fin y al cabo, nadie me obligó.
accept: Al fin y al cabo nadie me obligó.
yourTurn.why: *Al fin y al cabo* gives the final reason: "after all".

yourTurn.prompt: Say: Altamira may offer more. In any case, I'm not selling.
yourTurn.answer: Puede que Altamira ofrezca más. En cualquier caso, yo no vendo.
accept: Puede que Altamira ofrezca más. En cualquier caso, no vendo.
Puede que Altamira ofrezca más. En todo caso, yo no vendo.
yourTurn.why: You grant that the offer may grow, then *en cualquier caso* moves past it.

yourTurn.prompt: Say to a friend: In any case, call me tomorrow.
yourTurn.why: *En todo caso* and *en cualquier caso* are interchangeable here.

yourTurn.prompt: Turn it into a question with a worry first: *Nadie viene. Abrimos a las ocho.* (And if nobody comes? We open at eight anyway.)

accept: ¿Y si no viene nadie? De todos modos, abrimos a las ocho.
yourTurn.why: The worry comes first, and *de todos modos* sets it aside.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: We have little money. In any case, we open tomorrow.

accept: Tenemos poca plata. En todo caso, abrimos mañana.
yourTurn.why: *En cualquier caso* steps over the problem and gives the plan.

pitfalls.wrong: Es caro. Es decir, de todos modos, es la única opción.
pitfalls.right: Es caro. En cualquier caso, es la única opción.
pitfalls.why: Almost. *Es decir* says the same thing again. To set a worry aside, use *en cualquier caso*.
Almost. The phrase is *de todos modos*, with *de* in front.

pitfalls.wrong: Es caro y queda lejos. En cualquier caso, es caro y queda lejos.
pitfalls.right: Es caro y queda lejos. En cualquier caso, es la única opción.
pitfalls.why: The phrase leads to what matters, so give the conclusion, not the objection again.

personal: Think of a worry someone has about your plans. Write a sentence that admits it and sets it aside with *de todos modos* or *en cualquier caso*.
